ctx.x: Wait a minute. This is . There it's going now. Is he ever going to tell about Pirone? Oh, yes.

I was going to say about Pirone. I had seen some particular fellow, a lady in years there was this big image of Pirone. I always thought that the two could pass for brothers. Now, if you remember Ben Burnie, if you saw Ben Burnie, you saw A.J. Pirone because it looked so much alike. And I think they both had short legs, right?
I didn't know that Burnie, I knew that I heard that about Pirone.
